name: spotlight-card1
title: Spotlight Bento Grid
description: A rounded black panel of photo tiles arranged in a bento grid, one large and two small. A faint light tracks the cursor, and one card can carry a heading and paragraph.
use: A landing section needs varied tile sizes to show several features at once.
avoid: Tiles load local webp files from /public, so the grid breaks without those assets.
a11y: All images share the alt text "grid", so the tiles are not described. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark bento grid of image tiles: a square photo of a brick hall sign, a wide sunlit field under a blue gradient sky, and a large pale tile with blue jellyfish-like forms and wisps scattered across it.
behaves: A faint radial highlight follows the pointer over the tiles and a soft gradient tracks it inside each card. The pictures themselves never move or animate.
customise: The five tiles' image paths, titles and spans are a hardcoded array; swapping the webp files and editing that array is the way in.
weight: light: Five static image tiles plus a pointer-tracked gradient.
demo: A brick hall sign, a sunlit field and blue jellyfish images
issues: The heading and paragraph meant for the large card are not visible in any frame.
Every image repeats the same alt text, "grid".
polishWhy: Balanced bento proportions and vivid photos, but the promised text block never appears.
